pd_new_teacher_mentoring_001.evidence: Recruit, develop, and assign mentor teachers with the newest staff to ensure that each new Teacher is assigned a mentor. Provide ongoing support and mentoring for all new teachers throughout the 3-year induction program.

pd_teacher_leadership_002.evidence: every DCPS School shall be provided with a full-time Instructional Coach, whose sole responsibility shall be to provide professional development in a job-embedded manner.
